optimizer: full-batch float64 Adam, lr=0.000195, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-08, gradient clipping at 100
description: Stepwise pairwise boundary completion for a target containing K'''. The stages are trained with Adam. A derivative atom is inserted when the active pair separation falls below a fixed fraction of its value at the start of the current stage. The first plot column includes the fixed translated-architecture Adam control. No least-squares refits or prescribed center-shrinking schedule are used in the plotted curves. The extra order-zero center is initialized away from the matching target center and is trained with Adam. A guard penalty keeps this center away from the collapsing derivative cluster; reported errors are unpenalized relative L2 errors.
